name: Adelaide University Online Grant
summary: One-off $1,500 for commencing AU Online students with financial disadvantage or who live outside major cities.
who: Commencing undergraduate or postgraduate coursework student studying online in an AU Online program of at least two years
Australian citizen, permanent resident or New Zealand citizen
Financial disadvantage and/or a regional, rural or remote home postcode
how: Apply via MyScholarships on the Student Portal
catches: The latest listed round opened Monday 27 July 2026 and closed Sunday 23 August 2026
Must be used in the year it is offered
